hook: A fluorinated COF membrane lets oxygen in and keeps water out, giving lithium-air cells 2700 h of cycling
hook_turn: giving lithium-air cells 2700 h of cycling
summary: Water is smaller than oxygen, so size-based filters fail for lithium-air batteries. A membrane with fluorinated chains repels polar water while passing oxygen, supported by molecular dynamics. In 40% humidity air the cell cycled 2700 h, 10.8 times longer than an unprotected one, though this was tested in lab coin-type cells only.
title: Breaking the “Micro-Size Inversion” Paradox via a Surface-Chemistry-Driven Molecular Sieving Membrane for Ambient Lithium–Air Batteries
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
